facts: Mike told us he's taking pole and the win, and he's named Dustin as the driver he expects to end up in the wall.
Mike races for Saint Jude Children's Research Hospital tonight, a cause close to his heart as a father of three daughters.
Hyde Grand Prix Engineer takes its name from Mike's Air Force call sign, honoring his military service.
Mike delivered on his exact prediction last time out: pole position and the race three win.
Mike says Dustin doesn't concern him, despite Dustin naming Mike as the man he most wants to beat.

armed.on_podium: He told Sienna he was taking pole and attacking from the front, and here he is.
armed.on_lead: He told Sienna he'd qualify on pole and attack right away, and he meant every word.
armed.on_win: He told Sienna he was taking pole and the win, and he's delivered exactly that.
